<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='g' and n['pixels']>=20: out['frame']=n['boundary']
        if n['color'] in ('p','W') and n['pixels']>=40 and n['boundary'][0][0]>20:
            out.setdefault('blocks',[]).append((n['color'],n['boundary'],n['pixels']))
    return out
print("before", snap())
action(['DOWN'])
print("after DOWN", snap())
action(['LEFT'])
print("after LEFT", snap())
action(['UP'])
print("after UP", snap())
</parameter>
</function>
